# Solas 1.0.2
## ✨ What's new
- Refreshed app icon.

# Solas 1.0.1
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Pause when using other apps now rests a screen only while another app's window covers most of it. Dragging desktop icons no longer freezes the pond, and small windows, tooltips, and Finder's desktop leave the water running. - Click ripples no longer go silent until relaunch after a sleep/wake, display wake, or user-session switch; Solas re-registers its click monitors on those transitions and refreshes them periodically, so a silent failure recovers within seconds instead of waiting for a relaunch. - A right-click menu can no longer swallow a later desktop click: the next left click resolves the suppression even when it lands on a menu item or another app.

# Solas 1.0
First release.
## ✨ What's new
- Living pond wallpaper: sits above your wallpaper, below your icons. - Weather presets plus Follow Device Time, from dawn to moonlight. - Water color, clarity, touch ripples, currents with strength, speed, and core glow. - Fish with behavior modes plus feed-the-fish (hold and click to sprinkle food), active koi counts. - Decorations: lily pads, flower styles and counts. - Motion speed, performance controls (pause on battery, pause when using apps, frame rates, Pixel/Balanced/Smooth quality), launch at login. - 3-day free trial, then one license covers up to 3 Macs. - Automatic updates via Sparkle with About-pane toggles.
